---
title: "Distribution model macros"
format:
  pdf:
    include-in-header:
      - ../macros.qmd
---

Distribution family and member: DFAM $\distfam$, DFAMSUB $\distfamof{\text{lin}}^2$, DMEM $\distmem$, DMEMSUB $\distmemof{\theta}^2$.

Fitted distribution model: EDMEM $\edistmem$, EDMEMSUB $\edistmemof{\trainset}^2$.

Prediction family: PFAM $\predfam$, PFAMSUB $\predfamof{\text{lin}}^2$.

True mean function: TMF $\truemeanf{x}^2$, TMFSUB $\truemeansubf{\Outvar \given \Predvar}{x}^2$, CMEAN $\cmean^2$, CMEANF $\cmeanf{x}^2$, CMEANFTALL $\cmeanf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$.

Growth function: GROWTH $\growthfn$, GROWTHAPP $\growthfnf{2n}^2$.

Mean-function component: MEANSUB $\meanfnof{\distmem}^2$, MEANAPP $\meanfnoff{\edistmem}{\predvar}^2$, MEANTRUE $\meanfnoff{\popdist}{\predvar}$, MEANTALL $\meanfnof{\frac{a}{b}}$.

Binary classes: POSCLASS $\posclass_1^2$, NEGCLASS $\negclass_1^2$, NTP $\ntp^2$, NFP $\nfp^2$, NFN $\nfn^2$, NTN $\ntn^2$.

```{=latex}
\newsavebox{\withexp}\newsavebox{\withoutexp}
\sbox{\withexp}{$\meanfnoff{\distmem}{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\meanfnoff{\distmem}{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt EXPRISES\else EXPSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\growthfnf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\growthfnf{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt GROWTHRISES\else GROWTHSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\vcdimf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\vcdimf{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt VCRISES\else VCSTUCK\fi
```
